description: This file is a React-like component written in TypeScript using the Qwik framework. It provides a user interface for managing storage locations, including functionalities to create, edit, delete, and display locations in a table with modal dialogs.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form state for creating a new location.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with existing location data for editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Creates a new location or updates an existing one based on the current mode.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes a location by its ID.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the modal dialog by unchecking its checkbox element.
